capabilities: Run Python code blocks with a local interpreter
Show stdout and errors in a modal
Copy selected or full output to the clipboard
Run all Python blocks in the active note from one command
Schedule daily, weekly, or one-time runs that save output to notes
extras: Desktop-only; it launches a local Python process and does not work on Obsidian Mobile. Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later. Runs are not sandboxed: Python code has the same OS permissions as Obsidian. Executions longer than 30 seconds are stopped. Obsidian must stay open for scheduled tasks to run. An older build used the obsidian-yuhanbo-python ID.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to execute Python code blocks, so output must be produced outside the app and pasted back into notes.
summary: Plugin that runs Python code blocks with a local interpreter and shows their output in a modal inside Obsidian.
